CS=0x2000;DS=0x1048;C=CS<<4;D=DS<<4
u=Uc(UC_ARCH_X86,UC_MODE_16);u.mem_map(0,0x100000);u.mem_write(C+0x5798,bytes(code[0x5798:0x5808]));u.mem_write(C+0x3d41,bytes(code[0x3d41:0x3d7f]));u.mem_write(C+0x583f,bytes(code[0x583f:0x5842]));u.mem_write(C+0x370e,b'\0\0');ctx={}
def intr(u,no,data):
 assert no==0x21 and u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_AH)==0x3f
 assert u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_BX)==ctx['h'] and u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_CX)==ctx['request'] and u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_DX)==0x6000
 ctx['calls']+=1

 u.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_AX,ctx['error'] or ctx['actual']);flags=u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_EFLAGS);u.reg_write(UC_X86_REG_EFLAGS,(flags|1) if ctx['error'] else (flags&~1))

 if actual>request:continue
 ctx.update(h=h,request=request,actual=actual,error=error,calls=0,payload=bytes((i*17+13)&255 for i in range(20)))
 for reg,v in [(UC_X86_REG_CS,CS),(UC_X86_REG_DS,DS),(UC_X86_REG_ES,DS),(UC_X86_REG_SS,DS),(UC_X86_REG_SP,0xd000),(UC_X86_REG_BP,0xe000),(UC_X86_REG_EFLAGS,2)]:u.reg_write(reg,v)
 u.mem_write(D+0x85e,b'\x34\x12');u.mem_write(D+0x86e,b'\xa5');u.mem_write(D+0x870,struct.pack('<H',limit));u.mem_write(D+0xa94,b'\0\0');u.mem_write(D+0x876+h,bytes([eof]));u.mem_write(D+0x6000,b'\xa5'*20)
 u.mem_write(D+0xd000,struct.pack('<5H',0xf000,CS,h,0x6000,request));u.emu_start(C+0x5798,C+0xf000,count=200)
 called=h<limit and request!=0 and not eof
 assert ctx['calls']==int(called)
 expectedax=0x900 if h>=limit else (0 if not called else (0x900|error if error else actual));expectedcf=h>=limit or (called and error!=0)
 assert u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_AX)==(65535 if expectedcf else expectedax)
 assert u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_SP)==0xd004 and u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_BP)==0xe000 and u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_DS)==DS
 assert bytes(u.mem_read(D+0x85e,2))==(b'\x09\x00' if expectedcf else b'\x34\x12')

 if expectedcf:assert u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_DX)==65535
 expected=ctx['payload'][:actual]+b'\xa5'*(20-actual) if called and not error else b'\xa5'*20
 assert bytes(u.mem_read(D+0x6000,20))==expected;cases+=1
